highlights: Prächtige Wallfahrtskirche am Fuße der Serles
tipps: Nehmen Sie eine Trinkflasche mit, um das frische und beliebte Quellwasser direkt am Brunnen abzufüllen.
kurzbeschreibung: The Servite monastery Maria Waldrast at the foot of the Serles is one of Tirol's most tradition-steeped pilgrimage sites and the highest monastery in Central Europe.
beschreibung:
Spiritual Place of Power at the Foot of the Serles

Nestled at an altitude of 1,638 meters between the Wipptal and Stubaital lies the Servitenkloster Maria Waldrast. The site looks back on centuries of tradition as a place of pilgrimage and is considered the highest monastery in Central Europe.

Historic Pilgrimage Church and Miraculous Fountain

The Baroque Wallfahrtskirche houses the revered miraculous image of the Virgin Mary. In addition, many pilgrims journey here for the famous spring: the Waldrast-Wasser flowing from the rock has been prized for generations for its beneficial properties.
